verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai (HTTP 200) and per-page Markdown docs. Each .md page tells agents to fetch the llms.txt index, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also served. Many doc pages are published as .md URLs (e.g., CLI, Router, Agent API pages), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle.
